messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The product catalog can be released on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays; the previous Mon-Thu 09:00-17:00 UTC window no longer applies. [constraint; valid 2025-09-03 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-09-03]
    earlier: The product catalog can be released on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC; anything else needs an exception. [constraint; valid 2025-03-17 to 2025-09-03; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-03-17]
- Dashboards and alerts for the event bus are being repointed as of the 2025-11-24 handover. [valid 2025-11-24 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-24-event-bus]
- As of 2025-11-24, the Atlas team is taking over the event bus from the Boreal team. [decision; valid 2025-11-24 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-24-event-bus]
- On 2025-12-29 the Dune team observed that the event bus' request volume halved after the client rollout. [valid 2025-12-29 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-12-29]
- As of 2026-05-19, the job scheduler's leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds. [decision; valid 2026-05-19 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- The notifier relies on the bus for delivery events, so if the bus is down the notifier is down. [valid 2025-02-11 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-11]
- The webhook dispatcher relies on the bus for outbound events, so if the bus is down the webhook dispatcher is down. [valid 2025-02-11 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-11-2]
- Until 2025-11-24, the Boreal team looked after the bus; ownership then moved to the Atlas team. [valid 2025-11-24 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-24-event-bus]
    earlier: The Boreal team looks after the bus. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-11-24; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09]
- Deploys to the bus happen on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC and at no other time. [constraint; valid 2025-04-18 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-04-18]
- As of 2025-11-24, the Atlas team owns the bus, having taken it over from the Boreal team. [valid 2025-11-24 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-24-event-bus]
    earlier: As of 2025-08-15, the Boreal team still owns the bus. [valid 2025-08-15 to 2025-11-24; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-08-15-2]
- On 2025-09-23 the Dune team noticed that the bus' CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift and pinged the owners. [valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-23-2]
- As of 2025-09-23, the reporting service switched its data source from the ledger service to the bus because nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs. [decision; valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-23]
- On 2026-05-27 the Atlas team decided that the bus will retain messages for seven days, because replaying a full week has covered every incident recovery so far. [decision; valid 2026-05-27 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-05-27]
- On 2025-02-21 the Boreal team pinged the owners of the ledger service about the memory growth. [valid 2025-02-21 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-21-2]
- On 2025-05-07 the Boreal team pinged the owners of the authentication gateway about the error rate. [valid 2025-05-07 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-05-07-2]
- As of 2026-04-01, the pager for the indexer rings the Boreal team, not the Atlas team. [valid 2026-04-01 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-01-search-indexer]
- As of 2025-03-03, the pager for the webhook dispatcher rings the Ember team instead of the Boreal team. [valid 2025-03-03 to now; recorded by handover/2025-03-03-webhooks]
- As of 2025-12-05, the pager for the reporting service rings the Ember team instead of the Dune team. [valid 2025-12-05 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-05-reporting]
- On 2026-02-10 the Boreal team noticed that the indexer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-02-10 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-02-10-2]
- Oskar takes the first on-call shift of the year for the Ember team. [valid 2025-01-14 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-14]

Question: When can the event-bus be deployed?

message.reasoning:
The question asks when the event-bus can be deployed. Memory says: "Deploys to the bus happen on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC and at no other time." [constraint; valid 2025-04-18 to now]

Answer for now (2026-06-30): Thursdays 07:00–09:00 UTC.
